WHY USE IT
Save Time and Money on Every Post
Skip Studios and Retouching

Skip the studio day, the freelancer, and the retouch queue. The post still looks ready for the feed.

Show the Product Clearly

A clear product is easier to buy than a dark crop. Shoppers see the item, so it is less likely to sit unsold.

Invite a Bigger Order

A real setting makes the product feel worth buying with something else. Shoppers can picture it in use.

Post While the Offer Holds

Finish the visual in minutes, so you are not waiting on a shoot. Post it while the offer is still the one you planned.

WHERE TO USE IT
Instagram Photos and Other Ad Spots
Show a Morning Routine

Place a plain bottle in a work bag so the ad shows a commute, not the product alone.

Make the Carry Obvious

A sidewalk moment shows how the bag is used. Keep the product large enough to recognize when the photo is small.

Leave a Calm Area for the Offer

A desk scene keeps the product easy to see and leaves a calm spot for your offer. Add the price after download.

Show It in a Second Place

Put the same bottle on a gym bench, or move it to a holiday table when the next post is seasonal.

ONE PROJECT
Finish the Post in One Project

Brighten the shot, add your line, and export the square here.

Lift a Dark Photo

Raise the light on a dark product so the label is readable in the square you post.

Room for a Line or a Sticker

The square can hold a short line or a small sticker, so the offer sits where shoppers see it.

Stay in This Project

The retouch, the scene, and the square export all happen here. The file does not bounce between apps.

NO DESIGN HIRE
A Finished Look Without a Design Hire

You can finish a square without a designer on staff. Start from the cutout and stop when the product looks right.

Remove the Old Background

The clutter around the product can come off. The item is then free for a clean scene.

Add Light and a Soft Shadow

A soft shadow sits the product on the surface, so it stops looking like it floats.

Type and a Simple Shape

A short word can sit in the open space beside the product and still read at phone size.

Start From a Ready Layout

A holiday frame already has the border and the empty spot. Drop your product in instead of building a border from nothing.

NAME THE SCENE
Describe the Scene, Keep the Product

Your note only has to name the setting. The product in your upload is the part that stays.

A Background From Your Note

Name the room, the street, or the season, and get a background that fits the product you uploaded.

The Product Stays Put

The uploaded item is placed into the setting you described. It is not redrawn as a different product.

A Model When It Should Be Worn

If the piece should be worn, put it on an AI actor and keep that photo next to the flat one.

HOW IT WORKS
How to Make Social Media Posts in 3 Simple Steps

Bring a photo you already have. Leave with a square you can post.

Drop your product photo here
JPG, PNG or WebP · any clear photo works

Step 03
Finish and Download

Download the square, add your offer, and post it. You do not need a second app to finish the file.

WHY SELLERS USE IT
Work on the Ad Together

The person who writes the offer and the person who finishes the photo can share one file.

Edit Together From Anywhere

Send the square to the teammate who writes offers. They can edit it on a laptop while the original stays on your phone.

Share Logos and Colors

Keep marks, colors, and layouts in one shared library. The next post can pick up that same set.

Notes Before Anyone Exports

The offer writer can leave a note on the square. The change lands in the file before anyone downloads it.

SELLER EXAMPLES
How Stores Make a Square Post

Each seller turns one product photo into a square and skips the studio booking.

Example
Hiking Shoe Square for the Feed

They turn a packing-table photo of the charcoal hiking shoe into a square post. They publish it while the offer is still the one they planned, with no studio booking.

SHOE SELLER
Example
Cream Tote in a Square

They place the cream canvas tote in a square with room for a line they type later. The product stays the tote they uploaded.

TOTE SELLER
Example
Two Mug Squares Before You Pay

They try the cream mug in two quiet scenes, then keep the square that shows the mug clearly. They do not hire a photographer the night before.

ONE-PRODUCT SHOP
Example
Offer Added After Download

They download the matte teal bottle square and add the offer themselves. The photo does not lock in an old discount.

OUTDOOR SELLER
FAQ
Social Media Post Answers
Do I need to label a social image as AI?

Follow the platform’s current labeling rules when you post an AI image. Requirements vary by platform and location.
